query: Set me up to debug my web part in the hosted workbench on https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/test-site.
expected_behavior: Confirms the tenant profile and connectivity, then validates the toolchain
Runs scripts/setup-spfx-workbench.ps1 -ProjectPath ... -SiteUrl ... and relays the local, hosted and hosted debug URLs
Starts npx gulp serve --nobrowser and states the script writes nothing to the tenant

query: The browser shows ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID on localhost.
expected_behavior: Reruns setup-spfx-workbench.ps1 without -SkipCertInstall so the dev certificate is trusted
Does not tell the user to bypass the certificate warning

query: My web part does not show up in the hosted workbench.
expected_behavior: Checks gulp serve is still running
Treats 401 or 403 as a tenant or site URL problem and reruns the connection check
